points.description: Justification: in a pipe, fd[1] is the write end and fd[0] is the read end, so data is written to fd[1] and read from fd[0] (not the other way round / not both on the same descriptor).
points.partial_credit: Give 0.75 if the justification says only that one of the two roles is right or is vague, e.g. fd[0] and fd[1] have different roles.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says False and explains that fd[1] is for writing and fd[0] is for reading, in any wording. Part marks: False with a vague or half-correct reason. Zero for a True answer or a False with no justification, since the question gives no marks without a correct justification.
